measurement_scope: relational write surface (secondary index, unique constraint, foreign key, SQL INSERT/UPDATE via C API, 2-document SQL transaction), 1 and 8 writers, after collapsing the single-store coordinated-write path -- see lite-single-commit-write-path.md section 3.3c: sql.zig mutate()/sql_session.zig commit() now route a coordinated write through commitCoordinated (begin/writeTransaction/commitTransaction against the ONE table, no cross-database decision record) whenever the prepared plan touches exactly one table on a Lite single-file store, instead of always taking the full cross-database two-phase commit protocol in sql_commit.zig. A write whose prepared plan spans more than one physical table (foreign_key: child + parent inbound-reference bookkeeping) still takes the full cross-database protocol and is unchanged by this pass.
known_limitations: relational_txn_begin/relational_intent_write/relational_intent_resolve/relational_coordinator_hint stage tags were added this pass (write_amplification_trace.zig); durable_commits_per_write and syncs/update were already accurate before this pass, now the stage breakdown is attributed too.

foreign_key (2 participants: child + parent inbound-FK bookkeeping) and the explicit multi-statement transaction case are unaffected when they span more than one table; only the single-table coordinated/session-commit case was collapsed this pass.
mean_primary_group_size still reads 0.000 for every relational mode: group-commit bundling cannot be read off this field for relational writes (unchanged from before).
